description: This file defines the NetsimServer class and related classes (Chip, Device) for launching a network simulation server with virtual devices and FIFOs, integrating with the Cuttlefish configuration system. It includes methods for setting up network devices, forwarding ports via vsock, and generating commands for the netsim process.

classes.name: Chip
classes.description: Represents a network chip with a specific kind, holding input and output FIFOs, and capable of appending its info as JSON to a command.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a network device with a name and a collection of Chips, capable of appending its JSON representation to a command.

classes.name: NetsimServer
classes.description: Main class responsible for launching and configuring the netsim server, managing devices, and generating commands for network simulation.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates a list of commands to start the netsim server and port forwarding proxies.

methods.name: AddDevicesParameter
methods.description: Adds the JSON representation of devices to a command.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Sets up the devices and FIFOs for the network simulation based on configuration.

methods.name: MakeFifo
methods.description: Creates a FIFO file for a given device instance and relative path.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the feature, 'Netsim'.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the netsim feature is enabled based on configuration.
